title: Генератор новой партии v1
scope: Specification and executable orchestration skeleton for creating one new game party from free player input using world_base and party_database_v1.
non_goals: No hidden state passed to player-facing prose

pipeline.validation_gates: Request is treated as desire, not fact; no world entities are fixed yet; modern/impossible terms are flagged.
pipeline.repair_on_fail: Ask LLM to restate request as historically adaptable intent; preserve player core idea.
pipeline.notes: No character sheet, no class picker, no deterministic defaults.

pipeline.validation_gates: year in 1230-1250; season set; region exists; historical pressure references source_records or approved/usable records.
pipeline.repair_on_fail: Return frame to LLM with missing/invalid fields and allowed region/year list.
pipeline.hidden_allowed: yes, for historical pressure not known to character
pipeline.player_visible: no raw data; only progress text
pipeline.notes: If user did not specify year/region, LLM selects within project bounds and fixes before later steps.

pipeline.input_sources: HistoricalFrameDraft; world_base region templates; graph nodes/edges; weather and seasonal rules
pipeline.validation_gates: Only approved/usable_with_caution/draft-with-label records used; no source status upgrade; neighboring regions kept as outlines.
pipeline.repair_on_fail: Fail closed; require explicit list of missing regional records.

pipeline.input_sources: ActiveRegionContext; historical timeline; current year/season; source_records
pipeline.validation_gates: No future-certainty leaks; each event has phase/current signs/what PC can know vs cannot know.
pipeline.repair_on_fail: Ask LLM to separate objective hidden event state from character knowledge.
pipeline.player_visible: only visible signs later through visible context
pipeline.notes: Historical pressure creates world movement, not rails.

pipeline.input_sources: ActiveRegionContext; graph_nodes G1-G4; place templates; route templates; player request
pipeline.validation_gates: selected nodes exist or are materialized by LLM with cause; place has function, controller, access, routes, season, reason to start.
pipeline.repair_on_fail: Return to LLM with failed reason: missing route/function/controller/season/access/graph chain.
pipeline.notes: Prefer canonical G1-G4 from world_base; local additions must be marked party-created.

pipeline.human_stage: Разворачивание локации, минилокации и точки сцены
pipeline.input_sources: StartPlaceDraft; G4 location profiles; G5 template rules; current season/time/weather
pipeline.validation_gates: region_id/place_id/location_id/minilocation_id/anchor_id all set; anchor is physically useful for access/visibility/actions.
pipeline.repair_on_fail: Ask LLM to produce concrete minilocation and anchor grounded in selected G4 type.
pipeline.hidden_allowed: yes, but not passed to prose directly
pipeline.notes: This is the entry point for startup G5 materialization; detailed G5 pack comes in next project step.

pipeline.input_sources: StartRequestNormalized; HistoricalFrameDraft; StartPositionChain; social roles; occupations; item profiles
pipeline.validation_gates: status/provenance/body/skills/items/knowledge/obligations all grounded; request adapted; balance rules applied; no impossible status without cost.
pipeline.hidden_allowed: limited: unknowns and false beliefs may be encoded separately
pipeline.player_visible: only final visible identity and sensations
pipeline.notes: Character is a historically situated person, not an abstract camera.

pipeline.writes_to_party_tables: party_journal_entries; party_events; party_npcs (if relationship requires person)
pipeline.validation_gates: why here/why now is explicit; link uses work/road/debt/threat/order/illness/family/service/trade/captivity/etc.; no empty start.
pipeline.repair_on_fail: Ask LLM to create causally grounded link or downgrade character/status/request.
pipeline.hidden_allowed: yes for hidden pressure, but visible reason must exist

pipeline.input_sources: StartPositionChain; NPC generation profiles; social roles; occupations; place function
pipeline.validation_gates: NPC profile level is background/scene/key by memory needs; visible fields separated from hidden motives.
pipeline.repair_on_fail: Reduce over-detailed NPCs or add missing witness/access/relationship fields.
pipeline.player_visible: only visible participants and known facts
pipeline.notes: NPC depth depends on state that must be remembered, not prose length.

pipeline.input_sources: StartPositionChain; item profiles; container profiles; property rules; place templates
pipeline.validation_gates: significant items have class/material/state/placement/visibility/owner/holder/access/risk; containers pre-profiled before opening.
pipeline.repair_on_fail: Ask LLM to add missing owner/holder/access/risk or remove ungrounded item.
pipeline.hidden_allowed: yes for hidden objects/containers, not in visible prose unless signs exist
pipeline.notes: Player request must not retro-create an item.

pipeline.human_stage: Создание начальных маршрутов и карты знаний
pipeline.input_sources: graph_edges; graph_edge_knowledge_rules; character origin/status/occupation; current position
pipeline.validation_gates: known path != factual map; character knowledge level set; hidden routes not shown; access/season/risk copied or materialized.
pipeline.repair_on_fail: Ask LLM to separate factual routes from character-known routes.
pipeline.notes: Map shown to player is character knowledge, not complete graph.

pipeline.input_sources: HistoricalPressurePackage; StartCausalLink; NPC layer; item/property layer; scene state
pipeline.validation_gates: each tension has cause, trigger/time, affected subjects, visible signs, hidden/visible split.
pipeline.repair_on_fail: Reject free-floating quest hooks; require cause and consequences.
pipeline.notes: World starts moving; not all pressure is immediately visible.

pipeline.input_sources: all prior contracts; world_base FK/audit summaries; party schema rules
pipeline.validation_gates: no contradictions in year/region/season/position/status/NPC/items/routes/hidden/visible; all required party writes planned.
pipeline.repair_on_fail: Route failed contract back to responsible agent, not code fallback.
pipeline.notes: Semantic audit belongs to LLM; structural validation belongs to code.

pipeline.writes_to_party_tables: all target party tables in transaction order
pipeline.validation_gates: atomic transaction; no unresolved blocking issue; party_current_position complete; player-visible knowledge generated after hidden split.
pipeline.repair_on_fail: Rollback transaction; write validation issue; return failing contract to LLM repair.
pipeline.hidden_allowed: yes in DB; not in UI
pipeline.notes: Code writes approved data; code does not invent missing semantics.

pipeline.input_sources: persisted party state; visible-only projection; character knowledge; sensory state
pipeline.validation_gates: prose receives no hidden motives/items/future events/raw JSON; explains who/where/why/body/need/people/change.
pipeline.repair_on_fail: Regenerate visible packet first if hidden data leaked; then prose.
pipeline.hidden_allowed: visible selector yes; prose writer no
pipeline.notes: First player-facing output is generated only after persistence and visible projection.

contracts.purpose: Convert free player text into historically adaptable intent without fixing world facts.
Fix year, season, region and historical boundary before character/place generation.
blocking_validations: source_ids exist or unresolved source placeholder is needs_review

contracts.purpose: Retrieve region-relevant canonical data and template constraints from world_base.
blocking_validations: all IDs exist in world_base or are marked missing

contracts.purpose: Select relevant historical pressure and split objective event state from character knowledge.
blocking_validations: no exact future knowledge in character_knowledge

contracts.purpose: Choose or materialize start place and G1-G4 chain as a grounded graph node chain.
blocking_validations: at least one route or physical access relation present

contracts.purpose: Create concrete start minilocation and anchor for current_position.
Create historically constrained player character linked to start frame.
Explain why this character is here now and why the first scene matters.
blocking_validations: hidden reason not required for player comprehension

contracts.purpose: Create initial people/groups near the character at appropriate depth.
blocking_validations: visible fields separated from hidden fields

contracts.purpose: Create visible/significant item and property layer for first scene.
Initialize what the character knows about routes and places.
blocking_validations: factual graph not exposed as map knowledge
knowledge level set for every visible path
season/access/risk copied where character can know it

contracts.purpose: Create immediate tensions and hidden timers with causes.
blocking_validations: each event has cause and trigger
no quest hook without world cause

contracts.purpose: Run LLM semantic audit and code structural checks before persistence.
Define atomic insert/update order into party DB.
Create first player-facing visible scene and opening prose.

validation_rules.rule: Code may not create semantic world entities; missing semantics must return to LLM repair.
year must be integer between 1230 and 1250.
G1-G4 chain must be valid or marked as party-created by LLM with cause.
Start attributes/skills must obey documented balance and biographical basis.
Significant item must have place/status/owner/holder/access/risk or be removed.
character map knowledge must not equal factual hidden graph by default.
Tension/deferred event requires cause, trigger/time, result, and visible manifestation.
Prose writer must not receive hidden motives/items/future dates/raw JSON.
Party start writes must be one transaction or rollback on failure.
Draft/needs_review source may be used only with status preserved and audit note.

db_writes.required_fields: party_id, year, season, active_region_id, historical_frame_json, created_at
event_id, party_id, event_type, phase, hidden_state, visible_signs, trigger_json
node_id, party_id, canonical_node_id, scale_level, node_type, title, state_json
place_id, party_id, canonical_place_id, function, controller, access_state, place_state_json
party_id, region_id, place_id, location_id, minilocation_id, anchor_id, last_route_id
character_id, party_id, profile_json, attributes_json, skills_json, body_state_json
entry_id, party_id, character_id, item_id, carried_location, access_level
npc_id, party_id, profile_level, visible_profile_json, hidden_profile_json, current_location_id
item_id, party_id, item_class, owner_id, holder_id, placement, visible_state, hidden_state, risk_json
edge_id, party_id, canonical_edge_id, from_node_id, to_node_id, access_state, risk_state
knowledge_id, party_id, subject_type, subject_id, knowledge_level, known_to_character, known_to_player
event_id, party_id, trigger_json, hidden_state, visible_signs, affected_entities
issue_id, party_id, severity, step_id, message, repair_target
entry_id, party_id, journal_type, visible_text, knowledge_scope, related_entities

prompts.task: Преобразовать свободный текст игрока в адаптируемое намерение, не фиксируя игровые факты.
prompts.guardrails: Заявка игрока — желание, не истина. Современное/невозможное/слишком удобное помечать для адаптации.

prompts.task: Выбрать или принять год, сезон, регион и общий исторический фон в границах 1230–1250.
prompts.guardrails: Не выдавать персонажу знание будущего. Сначала зафиксировать рамку, потом генерировать место и персонажа.

prompts.task: Выбрать или материализовать стартовое место, связанное с регионом, хозяйством, дорогами, властью и текущим временем.
prompts.guardrails: Стартовое место не декорация. Нужны функция, держатель, доступ, связи и причина для старта.

prompts.task: Создать исторически правдоподобного персонажа внутри стартовой рамки и сцены.
prompts.guardrails: Персонаж связан с эпохой, статусом, телом, знаниями, имуществом, долгами и причиной действовать.

prompts.task: Создать людей рядом на уровне фоновых, сценических и ключевых NPC по необходимости памяти мира.
prompts.guardrails: Не раскрывать скрытые мотивы в видимом слое. Глубина NPC зависит от требуемой памяти последствий.

prompts.task: Создать видимые и значимые предметы, контейнеры, владельцев, держателей, доступ и риск.
prompts.guardrails: Предмет не возникает из заявки игрока. Значимый контейнер профилируется до открытия.

prompts.task: Проверить старт на историчность, связность, причинность и отсутствие утечки скрытого.
prompts.guardrails: Код не исправляет смысл. При ошибке вернуть конкретный контракт на repair.

prompts.role: Агент видимого контекста и вводной прозы
prompts.task: Сначала отделить видимое от скрытого, затем написать вводную сцену только из видимого пакета.
prompts.guardrails: Проза не получает скрытые мотивы, тайные вещи, будущие события, raw JSON и внутренние расчёты.
